items.q: Is The Park free to play?
items.a: Yes — free, in the browser, no account. Your banana walks straight in through the gate.

items.q: What do you do in The Park?
items.a: Keep a shared garden alive: plant, water other people’s beds, pull weeds, tidy, spot birds, hunt eggs. Everything nudges the health meter.
One number, 0–100, shared by everyone. It sinks on its own; tending pushes it back. A park nobody tends visibly dies.

items.q: Can you play The Park with other people?
items.a: Yes — every banana is a real visitor, live, and the garden is shared. The meter is the whole park’s score, not yours.

items.q: How do you unlock better seeds?
items.a: Harvest. Three harvests unlock three-star seeds, eight unlock four, fifteen unlock five — and thirty opens the six-star exotic tier.

items.q: How do you get to The Park?
items.a: Dress a banana in [the free builder](/make-a-banana/) and walk in. The rave and the bay are one road away.
